## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Alignment

Link the relevant ELF goal or contract and the evidence for this change. For a
material design decision, state the hypothesis and what would justify revising or
removing it. A routine fix needs only a short statement.

## Validation

State what was checked, the result, and any remaining gap. Update the owning
contract or current-direction record if this change alters its claims.
